evidence_notice: All electrical numbers/effects below are ENGINEERING ASSUMPTIONS; not measured larval physiology. No behavioral outcome was used to select them.

chemical_edges.warning: Uniform positive sign is a deliberately artificial reference scenario; transmitter/receptor signs are UNKNOWN. It must not be described as the measured circuit.

modulatory_edges.representation: DAN-d1 remains a separate modulatory event source; task feedback connection is a future explicit engineering overlay

plasticity.candidate_mask: all KC_to_MBON-d1 rows, inferred and not compartment-local
plasticity.learning_rule: not selected for this electrical reference

sensory_boundary.signal: current visible position bin represented by a fixed nonoverlapping 8-KC population code
sensory_boundary.codebook: sort KC source IDs ascending; divide them into 8 consecutive groups as evenly as possible; position bin 0..7 selects its group
sensory_boundary.selection_basis: predeclared physical fixture: with tau_m=10 ms, 12 mV-equivalent constant drive yields a single-cell threshold crossing within 1 ms; fixed before any circuit-level response is inspected

action_boundary.threshold: at least one Goro spike in a 100 ms response window
action_boundary.key_down: one fixed action if threshold met; otherwise no action
action_boundary.selection_basis: minimal integer event threshold fixed before circuit-level response is inspected

precommitment: No numeric value in this config may be changed after viewing controllability or learning outcomes; a replacement requires a new model version and must be treated as development, not confirmation.
